stemMd: Because the village hall is the only building with wheelchair access, moving the election meeting elsewhere would exclude some residents. The meeting should therefore remain in the hall, even though the hall is smaller than the gym. The gym's size is mentioned primarily to

options.label: B
options.textMd: show that the gym cannot hold the meeting.

options.label: C
options.textMd: state the conclusion of the argument.

options.label: D
options.textMd: acknowledge a consideration favoring the alternative that the author nevertheless rejects.

explanationMd: The concessive phrase introduces a genuine advantage of the rejected location. The author does not dispute that advantage; instead, accessibility provides an overriding reason to retain the smaller venue.

distractorRationale.a: Floor area does not establish wheelchair access.
distractorRationale.b: Being larger would not establish insufficient capacity.
distractorRationale.c: The conclusion concerns keeping the meeting in the hall.
